semiconductor_relevance: High — The company specializes in semiconductor front-end metrology equipment, which is crucial for wafer measurement and defect detection.
summary: AVANT Semiconductor Equipment Co.,Ltd, operating under the brand Eurex, provides high-quality front-end metrology equipment for the semiconductor industry. Their products focus on measurement, inspection, and electrical performance evaluation of semiconductor wafers, supporting manufacturing and research processes.
capabilities: Dual robotic arms for high productivity

regional_presence.China: Eurex has multiple bases in Shanghai Zhangjiang High-Tech Park, Wuxi Taihu International Science and Technology Park, and the Jinqiao Area of the Shanghai Free Trade Zone, emphasizing technological innovation in semiconductor metrology.
